T-031 is in review with Aquila and Bharath: the day output pipeline is live on Python 3.12, it generated the live Day 1 page and skipped it on a re-run. The commit (0332ee4) is not pushed because local main and origin have diverged, and T-024 was left to the other lane that holds it.

decisions.decision: Do this in order. (1) Switch the interpreter now, since it does not depend on T-024. Set ProgramArguments in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.ops.plist and in workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.ops.plist to /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3. Check that google api_core and the other deps import under 3.12, pip-installing any that are missing. Then bootout and bootstrap gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.ops and confirm the next tick.log has no packages_distributions error. (2) Clear the blocker yourself. T-024's remap is buildable Claude work, and its only blocker is a soft one. Map build.py slots to the v5 ids in questions.py, add a probe-outputs.mjs check that fails on any Q-number tag, and set T-024 to review. (3) Build ops/dayoutput.py and call it from tick.py. It pulls /admin/api/export/full survey_answers, fills dayN.html with headless claude (opus), stores ops/outputs/<attendee>/<day>.html, and keys on (attendee, day, updated_at). Prove it on the live day1 row, run it a second time to confirm no regeneration, then set the task to review.
decisions.why: T-024 log (2026-10-08 pass 2) shows the only blocker is a Q-number remap Claude can do, and its T-022 dependency is soft ('build against the live ids now'). The plist fix is independent. The orchestrator-autonomy rule (2026-10-09) says build end to end.
